name: Dimitri Volkov
bio:
Dimitri's culinary journey began in his grandmother's bustling kitchen in Moscow, where he learned the art of preparing hearty, traditional Russian meals. A passionate motorsports fan since childhood, he saw an opportunity to combine his two loves by becoming a catering manager within the racing world. After graduating from culinary school, he honed his skills in several high-end restaurants before making the leap to motorsport.

Dimitri understands that a well-fed team is a productive team. He meticulously plans menus, sourcing the freshest ingredients to create nutritious and delicious meals that cater to the dietary needs of the entire Birel ART Factory team. His pragmatic approach ensures efficient kitchen operations and minimal waste. He's known for his ability to adapt menus on the fly, accommodating last-minute requests and dietary restrictions with ease, ensuring everyone is always fueled and focused.

What sets Dimitri apart is his creative flair in incorporating local flavors into his menus, providing a taste of home even when the team is on the road. He believes that food can be a source of comfort and morale, particularly during the stressful race weekends. Dimitri's dedication and innovative approach have made him an indispensable part of the Birel ART Factory team.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly trimmed with a slight side part.
physical.description: Dimitri is of average height, with a sturdy build, and always sports a friendly smile.

quirks: Insists on using only locally sourced ingredients whenever possible, even if it requires a significant detour.
Always listens to classical music while prepping meals, claiming it enhances the flavor.
Secretly tests new recipes on the team mechanics, gauging their reactions before adding them to the official menu.
